utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — I’m still waiting on the exact time and place before I pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: No problem — just let me know when you have the time and place, and I’ll help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, I will — I just want the exact time and place before I share it with anyone.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I don’t have the exact list yet, but I can ask around and let you know what’s been gathered so far.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Tess — that’d be great. Send me whatever you gather, and I’ll pass it along to everyone right away.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it — I’ll ask around and send over whatever I can gather as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh good, that sounds like it’s coming together nicely — I’ll keep an eye out for the confirmed details.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks Nell — I’ll keep spreading the word once the details are confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Jules — I appreciate it. I’ll wait for the confirmed details and keep an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure thing — once you send me the list, I’ll spread the word and help line up the neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect — I’ll send over the list and come by after dusk to check the back fence first.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — send me the list, and I’ll get the neighbors lined up to help out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you send the repair drive details one more time so I don’t miss anything?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: The closest stop with tools is the hardware tent by Maple and 3rd. That’s the quickest one.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Bo — can you share the exact pickup details one more time so I don’t miss anything?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It’s moving along nicely — we’ve got a few volunteers lined up, and I’m still confirming the last details. I’ll send the full update as soon as everything’s locked in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the time and place exactly? I’d rather have the details straight before I go.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — the repair drive is on Sunday at the community center. I’ll send the full details as soon as the last bits are confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—I’ll keep it simple and go straight to Maple and 3rd. If Sam has the repair list, I’ll check each item one by one.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect — I’ll bring the repair list over and we can go through it item by item. Thanks for keeping it simple.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, I’ll be there and we can go through it one item at a time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 9 to 11 on Saturday still works well for me — I’ll help spread the word around the school crowd.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks. I’m still set for the hammer and screwdriver set — can you tell me where to pick them up?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure — I can leave them by the school front office, and you can pick them up there on Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Opal — I’m still a bit fuzzy, but I think it’s the loose fence, the porch step, and that leaky gutter.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — for those repairs, head to the hardware tent by Maple and 3rd; that’s the closest stop with tools.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Opal — that’s super helpful. I’ll head to the hardware tent by Maple and 3rd and see what I can find.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll check on the loose fence, the porch step, and that leaky gutter while I’m out, then I’ll let you know what needs the most help first.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, that helps a lot, Ira — thanks. I’m still a bit scattered, but once I sort through the rest I’ll send you the list.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good, Noah — send it when you can, and I’ll keep an eye out for the main repair priorities while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Mara — I’m still tracking tape, screws, and a few spare lightbulbs. If you can bring any of those, I’ll note what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can bring tape and a few spare lightbulbs — I’ll note those so we don’t double up.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Mara — I’ve got tape and spare lightbulbs covered, so now we mostly just need screws. I’ll keep track of what’s still left.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend you a hammer and a screwdriver set for the repair drive. What do you need most?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus — the hammer and screwdriver set would help a lot. If you’ve got any extra screws, I can use those too, and I’ll keep sorting tools and handing things out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ve got extra screws I can set aside for you too. Thanks for helping sort and hand out the tools.
